scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/bot-runtime build && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/dashboard build
scripts.bot:start: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/bot-runtime build && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/bot-runtime start
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/environment typecheck && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/bot-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/dashboard typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/protocol test && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/environment test && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/bot-runtime test && pnpm --filter @minecraft-studio/dashboard test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
